title: Western Ghats as a paper diorama (AI)
storyboard: Generate (AI, labelled): paper-craft Western Ghats diorama, monsoon clouds hitting the west slope; no animals
caption:
A paper-craft mountain range, generated and labelled.

The Western Ghats are a UNESCO World Heritage Site and are older than the Himalaya; their forests help shape India's monsoon weather.

Source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre. Diorama: AI-generated (labelled). Elephant photo taken in Laos.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
